name: Cloudbeds
description: Cloudbeds reservations become events on the main guest's profile: Reservation Booked (once), Reservation Confirmed (each version of its status and dates), Reservation Cancelled and Checked Out. Each reservation is also kept as a reservation object (status, dates, nights, guests, total, balance, and whether it's paid in full), checked again every hour for arrivals in the next week, so the pre-arrival email goes only to stays Cloudbeds reports as paid in full. Guests are held back from marketing: they booked, they didn't sign up.

signature_secret.label: Webhook header value
signature_secret.help: A long random value you choose, for example the output of: openssl rand -hex 24. Give it as authHeaderValue (with authHeaderName X-Webhook-Token) when you create each Cloudbeds webhook.

credentials.name: api_key
credentials.label: Cloudbeds API key
credentials.help: An API key with the read:reservation scope (Cloudbeds → Account → Apps & Marketplace → API credentials). Used to fetch each reservation a webhook names and for the hourly payment check.

setup: Create the integration from this recipe and copy its webhook URL.
In Cloudbeds, create an API key with the read:reservation scope and save it as the credential api_key.
Pick a long random value and save it as the integration's signing secret. Cloudbeds doesn't sign webhooks; it sends this value in a header instead.

Create four webhooks with Cloudbeds' API: POST https://api.cloudbeds.com/api/v1.3/postWebhook (form fields) with object=reservation, action=created, endpointUrl=<webhook URL>, authHeaderName=X-Webhook-Token and authHeaderValue=<the same value>. Repeat with action=status_changed, action=dates_changed and action=deleted. Add ?propertyID=<id> to the address if your key covers several properties.
If the key covers several properties and this integration is for one of them, set property_id in the settings; reservations for other properties are ignored.
Optional: set currency in the settings (for example USD) to record each booking's total as revenue on Reservation Booked. Cloudbeds' reservation doesn't say which currency it's in.
Make a test reservation and check the delivery log: each webhook is followed by a fetch of the reservation.
Every hour, DumbMail lists confirmed reservations arriving in the next payment_check_days days (7 by default) and fetches each one again, because Cloudbeds sends no webhook when a payment is taken.

Guests are held back from marketing. The pre-arrival flow is a service message about their own stay, so it still reaches them. Review it, edit the email, and turn it on. It never includes door codes or other access details; add those yourself only through a channel that checks payment.
Guest documents, addresses, cards, notes and custom fields are never stored: only the fields the recipe reads are kept from each answer.

flows.name: Cloudbeds: pre-arrival
flows.description: Two days before check-in at 10am, a note about the guest's stay. Only while the reservation is confirmed and Cloudbeds reported it paid in full in a check at most three hours old and at least as new as the reservation's last change: checked when it's due. It follows the newest dates. A service message, with placeholders and no access details.
